subject: Copywriting
title: Influencer Copy: Everyone's a Copywriter
description: A fast breakdown of Influencer Copy: Everyone's a Copywriter for builders.

hook.text: Millions of creators write product captions daily on Instagram and TikTok. Amateur copy outsells professional.

buildup.text: Influencers write in first person, casually, with typos. Polished brand copy feels fake by comparison.

discovery.text: Authenticity became the new persuasion. 'I actually love this' from a real person beats any tagline.

twist.text: Brands now pay influencers to write copy that looks unwritten. Calculated casualness is the new craft.

climax.text: The best-performing ad copy in 2024 looks like a text message from a friend. Professional amateurism sells.

punchline.text: The best ad copy now looks accidental. That's on purpose.

quiz.question: Why does influencer copy often outperform polished brand copy?
